title: Descent of a base structure and the fppf quotient of a kernel pair
statement: Let $S,U,R,M$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $a:U\to S$ and $b:R\to S$ be structure morphisms, and let $s,t:R\to U$ satisfy $as=at=b$. Suppose $q:U\to M$ is finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free] and surjective, $qs=qt$, and the induced morphism $k:R\to U\times_MU$ is an isomorphism with projections $s,t$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. There is a unique morphism $m:M\to S$ with $mq=a$. The singleton $\{q\}$ is both an fppf covering [def-pc-fppf-site] and an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Every fppf covering of schemes is an fpqc covering, and representable presheaves are fppf sheaves. Relative to the descended structure $m$, put $P(H)=U(H)/R(H)$ for $S$-schemes $H$, where $U(H)=\operatorname{Hom}_S(H,U)$ and the relation identifies $u,v$ exactly when $(u,v)$ is the image of an $H$-point of $R$. This is an equivalence relation, and the canonical natural map $P\to h_M$, $h_M(H)=\operatorname{Hom}_S(H,M)$, is injective on every $H$. It is locally surjective: each $H\to M$ lifts to $U$ after the fppf covering $H\times_MU\to H$. Consequently this canonical map exhibits $h_M$ as the fppf sheafification of $P$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Work in a universe containing the chosen big site and its morphism sets [def-weil-size-convention]; the conclusion can equivalently be expressed by the universal property of sheafification into any fppf sheaf.

proof.text: By the definition of finite locally free, $q$ is flat and locally of finite presentation. Together with its assumed surjectivity, this is exactly the definition of the singleton fppf covering $\{q:U\to M\}$. The fppf-to-fpqc covering lemma makes this an fpqc covering as well and proves the assertion about every fppf covering.

source.place: Tag 022C (lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc); definition of fppf coverings, Tag 021L

proof.text: Put k = (s,t):R → U×_M U. For any x,y:Z → U with xq=yq, the morphism r=(x,y)k⁻¹ satisfies rs=x and rt=y. Hence xa=rs a=rb=rt a=ya. Mathlib’s EffectiveEpi instance for the fppf cover q therefore supplies m = EffectiveEpi.desc q a, with qm=a. Its Epi instance gives uniqueness by cancellation. Set Q:U→M in Over S using this equation.

Mathlib proves fpqc subcanonicity from representable descent and obtains fppf subcanonicity by inclusion of the topologies. Subcanonical.isSheaf_of_isRepresentable gives every absolute representable sheaf. The proved subcanonical_over instance gives subcanonicity on Over S, and GrothendieckTopology.uliftYoneda supplies the required sheaf on the slice in the enlarged universe.

source.place: Tag 023Q, representable sheaf condition; topologies.tex Tag 022C

proof.text: For x,y:H → U in Over S, the lift r=(x,y)k⁻¹ from step 2 is over S because rb=rs a=xa. It follows that existence of r with rs=x and rt=y is equivalent to xQ=yQ. Equality of Q-images makes this relation an equivalence relation. Define η using coequalizer.desc applied to uliftYoneda.map Q, whose equalizing equation follows from sQ=tQ. The projection π is epi, its components are epi in Type, and therefore each π_H is surjective. Write two quotient sections as π_H(x),π_H(y). Equality of their η-images gives xQ=yQ and hence a common r. Evaluating the coequalizer equation at r proves π_H(x)=π_H(y), establishing injectivity.

source.place: Tag 03C5 (lemma-criterion-quotient-representable), condition (3), with the assumed kernel-pair isomorphism

proof.text: For f:H → M in Over S, map its pullback square with Q along Over.forget S. This functor preserves connected limits, so the resulting square of schemes is a pullback. Flatness, surjectivity and local finite presentation of q are stable under this pullback. The underlying first projection is thus an fppf cover. Evaluate πη=uliftYoneda.map Q at the second projection; the pullback equation identifies the result with the restriction of f along the first projection.

Let G be a sheaf and α:P → G. Put β=πα and let z in G(U) be its Yoneda section. The coequalizer equation gives s* z=t* z. For any p₁,p₂:Z → U with p₁Q=p₂Q, step 4 supplies r with rs=p₁ and rt=p₂, so naturality gives p₁* z=p₂* z. The singleton {Q} covers in the slice: fppfTopology.over S is the topology generated by fppfPrecoverage.comap (Over.forget S), and the image of this singleton is {q}. The singleton sheaf condition therefore supplies y in G(M) with Q* y=z. Let γ:h_M → G be the Yoneda transformation of y. Naturality of the Yoneda equivalence gives (uliftYoneda.map Q)γ=β, so cancellation of π proves ηγ=α.

source.place: Tag 03C5, expanded sheaf gluing argument for the quotient universal property

proof.text: For uniqueness, if ηγ₁=ηγ₂ then precomposition with π and πη=uliftYoneda.map Q give (uliftYoneda.map Q)γ₁=(uliftYoneda.map Q)γ₂. Yoneda identifies this equality with equality of the restrictions to U of the corresponding sections of G(M). The separatedness part of the singleton sheaf condition for {Q} makes these sections equal. The Yoneda equivalence then gives γ₁=γ₂. This proves the required bijection and hence the sheafification universal property, with no additional descent or sheafification theorem.

lean.statement: theorem fppf_kernelPair_quotient_descent {S U R M : Scheme.{u}} (a : U ⟶ S) (b : R ⟶ S) (s t : Over.mk b ⟶ Over.mk a) (q : U ⟶ M) [q.IsFiniteLocallyFree] [Surjective q] (hqs : s.left ≫ q = t.left ≫ q) [IsIso (pullback.lift s.left t.left hqs)] : Presieve.singleton q ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage M ∧ Presieve.singleton q ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage M ∧ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage ≤ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage ∧ (∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Presheaf.IsSheaf Scheme.fppfTopology (yoneda.obj X)) ∧ ∃ m : M ⟶ S, ∃ hq : q ≫ m = a, (∀ m' : M ⟶ S, q ≫ m' = a → m' = m) ∧ (∀ H : Over S, Equivalence (fun x y : H ⟶ Over.mk a ↦ ∃ r : H ⟶ Over.mk b, r ≫ s = x ∧ r ≫ t = y)) ∧ Presheaf.IsSheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (uliftYoneda.{max (u + 1) v}.obj (Over.mk m)) ∧ ∃ η : coequalizer (uliftYoneda.{max (u + 1) v}.map s) (uliftYoneda.{max (u + 1) v}.map t) ⟶ uliftYoneda.{max (u + 1) v}.obj (Over.mk m), coequalizer.π (uliftYoneda.{max (u + 1) v}.map s) (uliftYoneda.{max (u + 1) v}.map t) ≫ η = uliftYoneda.{max (u + 1) v}.map (Over.homMk q hq : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk m) ∧ (∀ H : (Over S)ᵒᵖ, Function.Injective (η.app H)) ∧ (∀ (H : Over S) (f : H ⟶ Over.mk m), Presieve.singleton (pullback.fst f (Over.homMk q hq : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk m)).left ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage H.left ∧ η.app (op (pullback f (Over.homMk q hq : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk m))) ((coequalizer.π (uliftYoneda.{max (u + 1) v}.map s) (uliftYoneda.{max (u + 1) v}.map t)).app (op (pullback f (Over.homMk q hq : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk m))) (ULift.up (pullback.snd f (Over.homMk q hq : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk m)))) = ULift.up (pullback.fst f (Over.homMk q hq : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk m) ≫ f)) ∧ ∀ G : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type (max (u + 1) v)), Function.Bijective (fun k : uliftYoneda.{max (u + 1) v}.obj (Over.mk m) ⟶ G.obj ↦ η ≫ k)
